# Clean CC0 skin base for offline anatomical baking

**Active source:** MargaretToigo, `toigo_light_skin_male_bronze`.
License: **CC0**, explicitly listed in the official MakeHuman Community
Natural male skins pack. `LICENSE_EVIDENCE.md` preserves its published table.

- Pack: https://static.makehumancommunity.org/assets/assetpacks/skins02.html
- Original asset: http://www.makehumancommunity.org/node/1136
- Downloaded 2026-10-18; ZIP CRC and byte length verified. Archive member and
  SHA256 are recorded in `provenance.json`.

The unchanged source is resampled through the original anatomical UV islands
into the smaller runtime head/body maps, with bounded colour tuning. Shane's
head geometry and artist-authored pigment/relief remain separate. This map is
not a source for his identity. No pre-painted injuries or makeup are intended.
The original image stays outside Godot's runtime asset tree. Normal detail is
authored by the player builder, rather than inherited from another character.
